training_details.bootstrap_note: Each tree draws at most max_samples rows with replacement from the full training pool; no global patient/row subset is discarded.
training_details.memory_note: Input is float32 memory-mapped data. sklearn is not incremental/out-of-core; tree fitting can page input and allocate working memory. Models run sequentially with bounded tree depth and worker count.

threshold_selection.rule: maximize validation F1; ties choose highest threshold

protocol.evaluation_unit: hourly record; patients remain disjoint across train/validation/test
protocol.test_role: final evaluation only; never used for training, stopping or threshold selection
protocol.validation_role: threshold selection and XGBoost early stopping; development metrics are selection-biased
protocol.calibration: Assessment of raw model scores; no post-hoc probability calibrator was fitted
protocol.class_imbalance: Training-only class weights; original validation/test prevalence retained
limitations: Hourly observations within each patient are correlated; these are point estimates, not independent-patient confidence intervals.
Hourly discrimination, including later positive hours, does not by itself measure early alert timing or clinical safety.
Class weighting can distort predicted probabilities; consult reliability curves alongside Brier/log loss and ECE.
This is a fixed research baseline, not an exhaustive hyperparameter search or external validation.
